Detailed Benchmark Results - PyRoot
===
The modAB algorithm is benchmarked against the bracketed root-finding methods of [PyRoot](https://github.com/SimpleArt/pyroot) by Jack Nguyen, in respect to number of evaluations and execution times:
* `bisect` - Bisection method (`method="bisection"`)
* `secant` - Secant method with bisection safeguard (`method="secant"`)
* `dekker` - Dekker's method (1969) (`method="dekker"`)
* `brent` - Brent's method (1973) (`method="brent"`)
* `chandr` - Chandrupatla's method (1997) (`method="chandrupatla"`)
* `ch_mixed` - Chandrupatla's method mixed with quadratic interpolation, the PyRoot default (`method="chandrupatla mixed"`)
* `modAB_SG` - Safeguarded Modified Anderson Bjork's method (Ganchovski & Traykov, 2023; improved 2026 by L.Tomov and N.Ganchovski)

All PyRoot methods are called through `pyroot.solver(f, a, b, method=..., x_err=1e-14, r_err=1e-14, refine=0)`.
The final refinement step is disabled (`refine=0`, default is 15), so that PyRoot stops at the same tolerance as modAB.
With the default `refine=15`, PyRoot needs 2176 evaluations in total with `ch_mixed` (vs 1822 with `refine=0`), and fails with `ZeroDivisionError` on f40 (`secant`) and f77 (`dekker`).

#### Notes:

Last Run on: 01.11.2026  
Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1065G7 CPU @ 1.30GHz (1.50 GHz) with 16.0 GB RAM  
Windows 11 Home  
Python Version: 3.14.7  
PyRoot Version: 0.2.0 - by Jack Nguyen (https://github.com/SimpleArt/pyroot), pure Python  
modAB_SG: pymodab version 1.1.3 - the safeguarded modab as native C extension built with MSVC 14.51  

PyRoot 0.3.1, the latest release on PyPI (identical to the GitHub master branch), was not benchmarked, because it does not work correctly:
its `chandrupatla`, `secant` and `non-simple` methods do not converge on most of the test problems (e.g. f05, x^3 - 2x - 5 on [2, 3], stalls at x = 2.0845 and never terminates),
and its `bisect` method raises `ValueError` from `log(0)` whenever one of the bracket ends is zero. The previous release 0.2.0 was used instead.

The source code to reproduce the benchmark is available in [RootBenchmarkPyRoot.py](RootBenchmarkPyRoot.py).
It imports pymodab from [PyModAB/src](PyModAB/src), so build the extension there first with `python setup.py build_ext --inplace`:
```
pip install pyroot==0.2.0
python RootBenchmarkPyRoot.py
```
